Khan Bhaini Presents Khan Bhaini's track "Family Routine" . The Track is another composition that has been produced under the label "Khan Bhaini". Having been sung and penned by Khan Bhaini, the track features a very light vibe that is bound to make you hum to its tune. The verses of the track are quite simple and meaningful in the melodious voice of Khan Bhaini.
